evidence.quote: We are adopting the Velociraptor retro format.

observations.why: Operational declarative performing the adoption of the format ('we are adopting'), which records a settled, acted-on position; decision-grade by its act.

evidence.quote: Each retro has three sections: Sailed, Stalled, and Capsized.

observations.why: Flat factual description of the format with no hedges and no settling act; a firm assertion that is not itself performing a ratification, so claim rather than decision.

evidence.quote: It replaced our old start-stop-continue format last sprint.

observations.why: Unhedged past-event assertion about the format's history; asserted but not performing a settling act, so claim.
